Owned product strategy and roadmaps that reduced order cancellations by 33%, improved incident resolution time by 35%, and maintained 99% SLA compliance in high-volume environments. Skilled in leveraging Mixpanel, New Relic, Mezmo, SQL, and generative AI tools to translate user behaviour and production telemetry into prioritised feature decisions.
